title: Build a request
description:
Write the exact text of an HTTP request.

```
GET /search?q=tea HTTP/1.1\r\n
Host: example.com\r\n
User-Agent: xenon-demo/1.0\r\n
Accept: application/json\r\n
\r\n
```
hints: The request line is `method + " " + path + " HTTP/1.1\r\n"`; the headers end with an empty line (lesson 3.01).
To show the line ends, replace each `\r\n` with `"\\r\\n\n"` when printing.
requirements: `buildRequest(method, host, path, headers, body)` returns the text with `\r\n` line ends.
A body adds `Content-Length` with its byte count.
Print it with the `\r\n` shown, so the line ends are visible.
stretch: Build the response side too: a status line, headers and a body.
